issue.standard_remedy: Fix the payment run to pay 2/10 invoices inside the discount window
issue.summary: 413 discount-eligible invoices paid without the 2% discount

plan.diagnosis: The manufacturer failed to capture 2% early payment discounts on 413 invoices, forfeiting $175,936 over the trailing 12 months. The root cause is a payment run configuration or process failure in SAP S/4HANA: invoices eligible for 2/10 net 30 terms were paid at an average of 42.2 days, well outside the 10-day discount window, with 53.3% paid late.

remedy_steps.step: Audit SAP payment run configuration (F110) to identify why discount-eligible invoices are not prioritized; verify baseline dates, terms of payment (ZTERM), and cash discount calculation settings in transaction FBZP.

Reconfigure automatic payment program parameters to prioritize invoices with early payment discounts; set payment proposal to sort by discount deadline and flag invoices approaching the 10-day threshold.
Implement weekly payment runs (instead of monthly or ad-hoc) and establish a dashboard in SAP (or BI tool) to monitor discount capture rate, days-to-pay, and at-risk invoices in real time.
Train AP team on revised payment approval workflows and escalation procedures for invoices nearing discount expiration; enforce policy to approve discount-eligible invoices within 5 days of receipt.
Conduct monthly review of discount capture performance with Finance and Procurement leadership; identify and remediate supplier-specific bottlenecks (e.g., invoice routing, PO matching delays).

plan.expected_impact: Capturing 2% early payment discounts on eligible invoices will recover approximately $175,936 annually, assuming the same invoice volume and terms.
kpis: Discount capture rate (target: >95% of eligible invoices paid within discount window)
Average days to pay discount-eligible invoices (target: <8 days)
Monthly discount dollars captured vs. eligible (target: $14,661 per month based on $175,936 annual opportunity)
risks: Cash flow constraints may limit ability to accelerate payments even with corrected system configuration
Invoice approval bottlenecks (PO matching errors, missing receipts) may persist despite payment run fixes
Lack of cross-ERP visibility (Oracle EBS, Dynamics 365, NetSuite, Coupa) may hide similar discount leakage in other systems
Supplier may change payment terms or discontinue early payment discounts during negotiation cycles
erp_actions: SAP: Reconfigure automatic payment program (F110) to prioritize discount-eligible invoices and set payment proposals to run weekly
SAP: Update terms of payment (ZTERM) master data to ensure 2/10 net 30 terms are correctly reflected and baseline date calculation is accurate (transaction OBB8)
SAP: Enable workflow alerts (transaction SWETYPV) to notify AP when discount-eligible invoices are pending approval >3 days
SAP: Create custom report (SAP Query or Fiori app) to flag invoices approaching discount deadline and track discount capture rate by vendor and purchasing organization
Coupa: Configure invoice routing rules to expedite approval for discount-eligible invoices and integrate discount deadline visibility into approval workflows
Cross-ERP: Establish centralized payment calendar and discount tracking dashboard consolidating data from SAP, Oracle EBS, Dynamics 365, and NetSuite to prevent similar issues in other ERPs
